text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I became Copano
Rickey's trainer. Right now,
she's staring
deeply into my soul.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you feeling a bit worn out?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You look kind of unwell, like you have a
headache. You've been
leaning forward
with your hands holding up your head for a
while
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't noticed, but now that she
mentions it, I do have a sharp
headache,
and my brain feels foggy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You don't have an idea? Hm, if you're
unaware, then it must be due
to... a pillar
in the landform.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Your office feels okay, so the problem
must be coming from your
room!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's no time like the present! I'll
do an impromptu feng shui
check! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I can stop her, she rushes off to
check the feng shui in my
room.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, I see...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aha, there's definitely something wrong!
Especially with the bedding,
I'd say. Oh,
but I'm not saying it's dirty or anything!
The place looks
clean! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But in terms of feng shui, there are areas
that I think we could
improve on to
enhance your luck!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
To be more specific, I see you're using a
towel as your pillowcase. It
might be
convenient, but it negatively affects your
luck in work
matters.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's also not great that both the curtains
and the bedcover have a
patterned design.
It makes the yang in the room overpower
the yin.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Is that your nightwear? It looks like you're
using old clothes to sleep
in. It's good to
reuse things, but you should probably buy
pajamas.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There's more I could comment on, but let's
start with this for now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We move things around and bring new
things in just as she instructs...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Put this here... and done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, the room does make
me feel a lot calmer now!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I know. It's hard to put into words,
but something feels
different. The power
you feel subconsciously—that's feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Keep your room like this, and... Rickey! ☆
Lucky! ☆ We'll be happy!
Teehee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My head feels a lot clearer, and I'm ready
to go. Maybe it's because
of my good
condition, but I'm feeling unusually
motivated.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Really? I'm so glad! You see, what we did
in your room was remove
the overhead
pressure!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by overhead pressure I mean the
things that cause you tension
while you're
sleeping.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For example, too many patterns around
you scatter your energy, and
sleeping on a
real pillowcase is better for your sleep
than a towel.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
By making these small changes, we
corrected the distortions in your
room, and
now you can sleep better, which leads to
better luck for
you!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This is the power of feng shui—the study
of environmental luck!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When your surroundings change, your
thoughts do too. And when
your thoughts
change, so do your actions, and even your
personality
too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So if you want to be happy, start with your
surroundings! Anyway,
putting the luck
talk aside for now...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, how are you feeling? Isn't your
head feeling clear and
refreshed? I bet
you're just bursting with energy, aren't
you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't you like to put this feeling into
words and share it with the
world? You do,
right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, why waste any more time! We've got
to spread feng shui far and
wide! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She drags me outside, and we spend the
rest of the day parading
around the
academy until the sun goes down.
